messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD-redis-primary — rule=maxclients_exceeded, current=10240 (threshold=10000), severity=P1. Auto-retries blocked, request queueing spike.
Samir P: acked — I'm on it, taking lead. Paging Redis infra.
Alice R: oncall here, joining. Any customer-facing errors?
Samir P: yes, a small % of API calls to /v1/generate getting 502/timeout from backend, latency spiking. Not wide yet but steady.
Miguel V: seeing Redis TIMEOUTS in app logs: 
```
2025-11-12T14:02:11Z ERROR redis: dial tcp 10.2.5.12:6379: connect: connection refused
2025-11-12T14:02:13Z WARN request queueing: waiting for connection (>500ms)
```
Samir P: ran quick check: `redis-cli -h prod-redis-primary INFO clients` output: 
```
connected_clients:10240
client_longest_output_list:0
maxclients:10000
```
Lena T: ouch, hitting maxclients. Did something ramp?
Samir P: traffic ramp from a model warmup job started by a customer earlier + a churn in short-lived connections from gateway.
Alice R: is this the ephemeral-conn pattern we've seen (clients not reusing pools)?
Miguel V: looks like it. A handful of services creating lots of dedicated connections instead of pooled ones. I see many connections with role=idle and short lifetime.
Samir P: mitigation plan: 1) block non-critical background jobs, 2) flip Redis readonly-only connections to read-replicas where possible, 3) temporarily bump maxclients on primary if safe, 4) reduce connection churn by enabling keepalive on gateway, 5) if not stable, failover to standby.
ops-bot: autoscaling action available: redis-standby can be promoted with 1-click but needs DBA approval.
Lena T: Customer impact? Which customers?
Samir P: preliminary — about 6 production tenants saw ~1-2% error increase on generation calls over last 7m. No billing or data loss expected, requests retried by client causing latency.
Alice R: I'll open a quick incident page and add customers in the notification doc. Samir, can you run `ss -ntp | grep 6379 | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr` to identify top IPs?
Samir P: running now... top offenders: 10.23.8.45 (app-gateway), 10.23.9.12 (model-warmup), 10.24.1.8 (legacy-batch).
Miguel V: advise: throttle warmup job and ask app-gateway to reuse pooled clients. I'll open PR to tweak pool config on gateway.
Samir P: increasing maxclients by +2k on prod-redis-primary via sysctl/TCP tuning — rolling now (low risk).
ops-bot: config change started: redis.conf -> maxclients=12000. Applying on primary (change will require graceful restart).
Lena T: any chance restart will cause failover?
Miguel V: we'll do a graceful config reload where possible, otherwise we'll sequence restarts to avoid full outage. Prefer not to restart primary if we can avoid it.
Samir P: deployed temporary iptables rule to rate-limit connections from warmup host (10.23.9.12) to minimize blast radius.
Alice R: good. PagerDuty escalation policy: if not stable in 10m escalate to DB team. Setting timer.
pagerduty: escalation timer set — escalate to DB-team oncall at +10m.
Samir P: monitoring: connections down from 10240 -> 9800 after limit + throttle. Error rate dropped by 0.6% in last 3m.
Miguel V: pushing config change to gateway to enable connection pooling: patch + rollout to 50% of instances now.
Lena T: Samir, can you confirm replicas still behind primary? Any replication lag?
Samir P: checked `INFO replication`: minimal lag, replicas healthy. Not promoting now.
Alice R: customer comms draft: "We detected elevated connection usage on Redis causing transient 5xx responses for a subset of requests. Engineers are mitigating; no data loss. We will follow up with RCA." I'll post to status once stable.
Samir P: handing off to follow-up oncall for 30m monitoring: @Alice R you'll take watch?
Alice R: taking handoff. Will escalate to DB if we hit >99% capacity again or if errors don't trend down.
Miguel V: follow-up action items: (1) enforce pooled connections in gateway, (2) add alert for short-lived connection spikes (rate of new connections), (3) run a postmortem and update runbook to include warmup job throttles.
Samir P: thanks everyone. Closing pager for now — monitoring. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident acknowledged by Samir P (P1 -> acknowledged).
